newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - May 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - May 13.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on the front page of its business section on May 13:
WASHINGTON - UUNet Technologies Inc said it would begin charging for some services it had once provided for free.
NEW YORK - The biggest winner of the chess match between an IBM supercomputer and Garry Kasparov may have been not the machine or even its human programmers, but the company itself.

WASHINGTON - Delta Air Lines Inc. Chairman Ronald Allen unexpectedly announced that he will leave the airline when his contract expires in July, amid speculation that a faction of the company's board of directors was dissatisfied with him and had pushed him to leave.
NEW YORK - The Dow Jones industrial average rose to another high, outpacing broader stock measures as investors remained cautiously optimistic about the outlook for inflation and interest rates.
